definition: A motor disorder and feature of the upper motor neuron syndrome characterized by a velocity-dependent increase in tonic stretch reflexes (muscle tone) resulting from hyperexcitability of the stretch reflex, clinically manifesting as muscle overactivity, high-tone spasms, and exaggerated tendon jerks.

source.title: The diagnosis and management of adults with spasticity
